title: Grounding Record
description: One entry in the Ontology Store (the epistemic floor). Binds a term to its math and a checkable proof. Physical/formal terms may be COMPUTED at the floor; ethical/value terms MUST NOT be grounded here and are routed to the governance ceiling (governance decides; the floor only grounds).

term.description: The natural-language token this record grounds (lowercased, canonical).

canonical_id.description: Stable content-address for this record (e.g. GR-bayes-implicit-icl).

aliases.description: Other surface forms that resolve to this record.

tier.description: Expansion tier from the Tier-1 root (E). Tier 1 = the root equation itself.

root_path.description: Trace from the Tier-1 root (E) down to this term. First element SHOULD be 'E'.

domain.description: Grounding class. 'physical' and 'formal' may be computed at the floor. 'ethical' MUST be refused by the resolver and governed at the ceiling.

math.description: The canonical mathematical statement (LaTeX or plain). Required for physical/formal; forbidden for ethical.

provenance.description: Ingestion source (e.g. arXiv:2111.02080). A record without provenance is a phantom.

sha256.description: Hash of the canonical record bytes (content-address integrity).

verifiable.description: Derived. True iff status == 'verified' (both ingestion gates passed).

status.description: Lifecycle state set by the ingestion gates.

corroboration.description: Non-LLM signals supporting this record's structural placement (source text span, external KG match, second-model agreement).

structure.description: Result of GATE S (symbolic structural validation). Deterministic; no LLM.

faithfulness.description: Result of GATE F (word->math faithfulness; contrastive + roundtrip drift detection). Null if GATE S failed first.

quarantine_reason.description: Present iff status == 'quarantined': the failing gate(s) and what must change.

then.description: Ethical terms carry no math and are never floor-grounded.
